Ukraine updates: Key bridges in Kyiv, Crimea hit in strikes
Published November 17, 2026last updated November 17, 2026
Kyiv's mayor said Russian forces have hit bridges on the Dnipro River. Ukraine launched a massive attack on Russia earlier on Monday, hitting the Crimean Bridge. DW has the latest.
What you need to know
- Russia struck two important bridges in Kyiv, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said
- Ukraine strike hits Kerch bridge connecting occupied Crimea to the Russian mainland, stopping traffic
- The attacks come as Ukrainian, European and US negotiators discuss future talks with Russia on ending the war
These are the main developments from Russia's war in Ukraine on November 17, 2026:
Crimea strike kills 2, says Russia-installed governor
A drone strike on Crimea has killed two people, according to the Russia-installed governor Sergei Aksyonov.
He said on Telegram that the strike took place in the Leninsky district of Crimea, which was seized and annexed from Ukraine in 2014.
Earlier Aksyonov said that Ukraine had struck the Kerch bridge, causing traffic to be suspended.
Moscow built the Kerch Bridge to link the annexed Crimean Peninsula to the Russian region of Krasnodar Krai in the northern Caucasus.
The route is a major source of supplies for Russian forces in Ukraine's occupied Kherson region and is a strategically significant target for Ukrainian forces.
Kerch bridge partially destroyed, according to reports
The Kerch bridge, which links the occupied Crimean peninsula to mainland Russia, has been partially destroyed, according to unofficial reports.
Photos on various Telegram channels appear to show that one of the arches and part of the roadway have collapsed following a strike.
Poland's Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski shared a picture on his X account showing a single arch where there should be two, simply exclaiming "Wow."
Reports on the extent of damage have yet to be confirmed by official sources, but images and videos of the bridge are being widely circulated in the Ukrainian media space.
Russia's Transport Ministry said there had been an overnight drone strike on November 17 leading to a temporary suspension of traffic. It advised motorists not to travel towards the bridge and wait for further information.
Russian strike on aid distribution center earlier in the month killed 72, Ukrainian officials say
Ukraine's national police said late Monday that the death toll from a Russian strike on a village in the southern Ukrainian region of Zaporizhzhia earlier this month had risen to 72.
Four people were still missing after authorities concluded a two-week search operation on Monday.
Russia hit a former school that was used as an aid distribution center in Komyshuvakha on November 2 as people were collecting humanitarian supplies. The attack was one of the deadliest of the war.
The village is located close to the frontline.
Ukrainian police said Russia had attacked the search operation several times during the past two weeks.
"Unfortunately, the shelling of Komyshuvakha on November 2, 2026, became one of the most tragic attacks since the beginning of the full-scale war," Ukraine's national police said.
Ukraine holds new talks with US, European negotiators
Ukraine held fresh talks with US and European negotiators on ending the war with Russia on Monday evening, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.
Ukrainian officials held online talks with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, as well as representatives from Ukraine's European partners.
Kushner said progress had been made towards an agreement, although significant challenges remain to finding a path to peace.
The online talks come less than a week after delegations from the US, Ukraine and Russia met in Abu Dhabi for their first trilateral talks in nine months.
"Diplomatic processes are actively underway and we hope that these efforts will not be in vain," Zelenskyy said. "Our team is working in the most constructive manner possible."
In his nightly video address, Zelenskyy also warned that Kyiv had intelligence that Russia would launch major strikes on targets across Ukraine on Monday evening and into Tuesday.
The Ukrainian leader warned that Russia "must know that for every act of evil they commit, there will be a just response from us."
In his remarks, Zelenskyy cited a Ukrainian intelligence report that said North Korea was supplying "dozens of ballistic missiles to Russia each month."
"This is extremely dangerous and not only for Ukraine," he said. "By using its ballistic missiles in this war, North Korea is making its weapons more effective. This creates additional challenges for the entire region around Korea."
Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge for second day in a row, Russian authorities say
Ukraine struck a bridge connecting the annexed Crimean peninsula and the Russian mainland late Monday.
The same bridge over the Kerch Strait was also struck a day earlier, Russian-installed authorities said.
"At the moment, traffic is suspended," Crimea's Moscow-installed governor, Sergey Aksyonov said Tuesday.
Russian officials also said Ukraine had struck oil refineries on Monday.
Monday's attack was the largest such assault on Russia since it launched itsfull-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Russia says it intercepted over 1,300 Ukrainian drones during the attack.
Overnight into Tuesday, Ukraine targeted Moscow with nearly 200 drones.
Moscow mayor Sergey Sobyanin said early Tuesday morning that Russian air defenses had downed 20 drones heading towards the capital.
Russia hits two major bridges in Kyiv: What we know
Russia struck two bridges over the Dnipro River in Kyiv late Monday, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.
"According to preliminary information, there have been hits on the North and South bridges in the capital," Klitschko said on Telegram.
In a later post, Klitschko said the attack "caused damage to critical infrastructure," adding that there were "disruptions to water and heating supplies" because of strikes.
Earlier this month and in October, a series of Russian attacks hit several bridges in the Ukrainian capital, causing major disruption.
Earlier on Monday, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy had warned Russia was planning strikes for Monday night and into Tuesday.
"Tonight, overnight, and throughout tomorrow, please pay attention to missile danger alerts," he said.
"And they there, in Russia, must know that for every one of their evils there will be our just response," Zelenskyy added.
Welcome to our coverage
Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko said two major bridges in the Ukrainian capital were struck in an overnight Russian attack.
The strikes damaged critical infrastructure and disrupted water and heating in parts of the city, Klitschko said.
Ukraine on Monday attacked Russia, targeting Moscow with drones and striking an important rail bridge in the annexed Crimean peninsula.
The latest exchanges come as negotiators from Ukraine, Europe and the US discuss future talks with Russia on finding a path to peace.
Stay with us as we bring you the latest developments related to Russia's war in Ukraine.

ראש עיריית קייב דיווח על פגיעה של כוחות רוסיים בשני גשרים חשובים בעיר הבירה, כמו גם בתשתיות קריטיות נוספות שגרמו להפסקות מים וחימום. במקביל, מתקפת כטבמים אוקראינית נרחבת כוונה לעבר חצי האי קרים ורוסיה, והביאה לסגירת התנועה על גשר קרץ' ולנזקים במבנהו. הרשויות ברוסיה דיווחו על יירוט מאות כטבמים בשטחן.

במישור הפוליטי, הנשיא וולודימיר זלנסקי ציין כי התקיימו שיחות מקוונות נוספות בין נציגים מאוקראינה, ארצות הברית ומדינות אירופה על מנת לבחון דרכים לסיום המלחמה. זלנסקי הזהיר כי רוסיה ממשיכה לקבל טילים בליסטיים מצפון קוריאה וכי מוסקבה מתכננת להמשיך בתקיפות נרחבות נגד יעדים אוקראיניים.
